params.name: cache_key
params.description: The cache key to look up

items.docs:
Retrieve detailed information about a specific cache entry using its cache key.
    This includes the original request, cached response, and metadata about the cache entry.

    The response includes:
    * Original request parameters
    * Cached response data
    * Cache metadata (creation time, TTL, expiration status)

    Example response:
    ```json
    {
        "cache_key": "abc123...",
        "request": {
            "query": "Show me the relationships between payment and vendor",

Retrieve the complete contents of the cache, including all keys and values.
    This endpoint returns detailed information about every cache entry, including:
    * Cache keys
    * Original requests
    * Cached responses
    * Metadata for each entry

    This is useful for:
    * Debugging cache issues
    * Analyzing cache contents
    * Backing up cache data
    * Migrating cache data between instances

Set one or more cache entries using the same format as the dump endpoint.
    This allows you to easily copy-paste the output from /api/graph/cache/dump
    to restore or update cache entries.
